|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1, the only known text of this card; it is the current text. The images are the Players Committee card image and the release-sheet slip, which both print it. The original text (first printing of the Virtual Block 7.3 sheet, official text as of 3 June 2011) has not been found, so it has no page here.
* '''Original''' (not found): the Players Committee news post of 23 June 2011 says the errata “is simply to accomodate the change to Rogue Insertion. The Rogues are no longer spies, so the text relying on spies being present at the Power Plant needed to be replaced with something achievable for Center of Tyranny.”<ref name="src-S6">Players Committee news post "5 immediate changes from the CBT", 23 June 2011 (immediate). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20110824051300/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=323:5-immediate-changes-from-the-cbt&catid=1:latest-news&Itemid=117 Internet Archive]</ref> The exact earlier wording is not known: the copy of the release sheet that survives was re-made on 25 July 2011 with the new text.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): given in full in the news post of 23 June 2011 (“Light (1): Attempts to 'disable' the Planetary Shield are +2 for each Rogue Squadron pilot here. Dark (1): While Center Of Tyranny on table, you generate no Force here.”)<ref name="src-S6" /> and in the re-made Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf#page=7 Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet] ("Official text as of June 3, 2011"; this copy was re-made on 25 July 2011, after the errata of 23 June 2011; the first printing has not been found), page 7, slip 40 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022223058/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf#page=7 Internet Archive]</ref>: Light Side “Attempts to 'disable' the Planetary Shield are +2 for each Rogue Squadron pilot here.”; Dark Side “While Center Of Tyranny on table, you generate no Force here.” Advanced Rulebook 2.0, Appendix A<ref name="ar20">[[Media:AR-version-2-0-final.pdf|Players Committee Advanced Rulebook 2.0]], Appendix A (Errata), p. A-5; PDF created by 27 August 2012 (announced earlier on the Players Committee rules forum; see the history above). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/2013/04/ar_version-2-0_final.pdf</ref> and the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013)<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=39, page 39. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=39 Internet Archive]</ref> print the same text. The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB7-p7-121-Coruscant_Main_Power_Plant.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-L-coruscantmainpowerplant-pre.gif]]) print it; the PC website card list (2012–13) shows no game text for this location. The same Competitive Balance Team errata was posted on the Players Committee rules forum on 22 June 2011, effective immediately, a day before the news post<ref name="pcforum-p632630">Players Committee forum, Rules board, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=48201, now titled “Current Rulings Archive July 2010 - August 2012”), post by Aglets, 22 June 2011 ([https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=48201&start=20#p632630 forum post])</ref>.
